class: The same fact in another shape: a value read as empty because of how the page draws it
symptom: The agent retyped Email and Mobile Number on every pass and stopped with "could not set: Email" on a form that was in fact filled in.
root_cause: A text box that carries a placeholder is drawn by the accessibility snapshot with its value as a child line ("- text: jane@example.com") rather than after its colon, and the parser only read the colon form. A phone box the site began with only its dial code ("+1") was also read as an answer.
why_tests_missed: No fixture had a text box with a placeholder and a value, so only the colon form was ever parsed.
fix: parse_snapshot reads the first child text line of an empty text box as its value; a value that is only a dial code is not an answer.
prevention: Read a field's value through every shape the page can draw it in, and test the reader with the real browser's snapshot over every placeholder shape and value, not with hand-written snapshots alone.
